decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a kick plate at the base of the door not less than 400mm high, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle not more than 1m above ground level. The openable element of the door shall have a solid frame not less than 4cm around the glazing.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby approved, is restricted to Use Class A5 (Takeaways). Any significant change in the proposed use (ie. requiring change in use class) shall not occur without further planning permission or consent from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The extract system shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher.The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.

Condition : 8 - The extract system shall not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at a maximum, the noise levels shall be 10bB(A) lower than the BNL. To achieve this the following measures shall be adopted.
1.	The fan unit and filters shall be located within the building, or if it is to be located outside the building, they shall be housed within an acoustic enclosure
2.	Silencers shall be provided to one or both sides of the fan as necessary
3.	Ducting shall be configured to minimise turbulent air flow with no acute bends or duct constrictions
4.	Ducting shall be circular
5.	The fan shall be isolated from inlet and outlet ducting using flexible couplings
6.	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts
7.	The ducting shall be isolated from the building structure using anti-vibration mountings and a packing material where it passes through any solid structure
Condition : 9 - The extraction and noise control systems as detailed in Conditions 7 and 8 above shall be full implemented before the use is commenced
Condition : 10 - The ceiling/floor separation shall comply with the minimum construction/insulation standards set out in the building regulations.
Condition : 11 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8 am to 11 pm on Monday to Saturday and 10 am to 10 pm on Sundays and public holidays.
description: Change of use from A1 (Retail) to A5 (Takeaway) incorporating a new access ramp and a single storey rear extension and extractor duct to the rear.
